notes: «أبو سلمة، يحيى بن خلف» is one man (kunya, comma, name: rule 7)
The second route opens with «وعن»; the text writes no head of its own for it, so it starts at عبد الرحمن بن القاسم and no shaykh is added; flagged for the reviewer
«عن أبيه» with no name is a relation link; Aisha is the last link in both routes, and her words («لقد نزلت آية الرجم») are the one saying
